STEP 1 - Scene: A mixed green side salad (mesclun-style leaves with shredded carrot, a few dark berries or raisins, and slivered almond bits) on a white square plate, with a corner of a pizza or flatbread (cheese and tomato sauce) at the top edge. The photo is taken from above, roughly top-down, with slight perspective.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The white square plate is roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 530 cm² for a round-equivalent; the plate's visible food-bearing region is the left portion. Treat the plate as ~26 cm.

STEP 3 - Items: mixed leafy greens (spinach, arugula, red leaf), shredded carrot, dark dried fruit/berries, a few almond slivers, a small amount of dressing sheen. The pizza crust/cheese piece at the top edge belongs to a separate item and is mostly off the plate's food area; I count only the salad.

STEP 4 - Area: Mixed greens ~17% of plate area (~90 cm²). Carrot shreds ~1% (~5 cm²). Dark fruit/berries ~1% (~5 cm²). Almond bits <1%. Total food coverage ~19% of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume: Mixed greens 90 cm² x 3 cm ≈ 270 ml (airy pile). Carrot 5 cm² x 1 cm ≈ 5 ml. Dried fruit 5 cm² x 1 cm ≈ 5 ml.

STEP 6 - Grams: Greens 270 ml x 0.15 ≈ 40 g. Carrot 5 ml x 0.6 ≈ 3 g. Dried fruit 5 ml x 0.6 ≈ 3 g. Almonds ~1 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Leafy greens ~20 kcal/100 g → 40 g ≈ 8 kcal. Carrot ~40 kcal/100 g → 3 g ≈ 1 kcal. Dried berries/raisin-type ~300 kcal/100 g → 3 g ≈ 9 kcal. Almonds ~580 kcal/100 g → 1 g ≈ 6 kcal. Dressing sheen not clearly visible; omitted.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A few handfuls of leafy greens remaining on a plate with light garnish gives roughly 40–50 g and under 30 kcal, which is plausible for visible leftovers. Total ≈ 47 g, ≈ 24 kcal (excluding any dressing).
